## Notes for Higher-Level Synthesis

- **Core Foundation**: IrModel and IrModelFields form the model registry backbone; all model/field management flows through here.

- **Access Control**: IrRule handles record-level security (domain-based); works with ir.model.access for object-level controls.

- **Routing & HTTP**: IrHttp is the HTTP boundary layer, coordinating authentication, URL conversion, and request dispatch.

- **Action Dispatch**: IrActions and subclasses (ActWindow, Server, Client) form the action execution layer; IrActionsServer allows embedded Python execution and webhooks.

- **Domain Models**: Partner (company/contact), Users (auth + groups), and Lang (i18n) are foundational business entities.

- **Metadata Sync**: The _reflect_* methods bridge runtime definitions with database schema and XML IDs.

- **Scope**: Data model and ORM infrastructure only; no business logic (sales, accounting, HR), no reporting, no workflows.

- **Boundary**: IrHttp is the HTTP entry point; IrActions is the action/workflow entry point; IrRule+IrModel.access is the security boundary.
